# NexaCloud Analytics Dashboard  
A real-time data visualization platform for SaaS businesses, built with React and Node.js. This project streamlines actionable insights from raw data, enabling teams to monitor KPIs, forecast trends, and optimize operational efficiency.  

## Badges  
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/kamilaszymanska/nexacloud)  
[![CI/CD](https://img.shields.io/badge/CI%2FCD-passing-success)](https://github.com/kamilaszymanska/nexacloud/actions)  
[![Size](https://img.shields.io/badge/Size-120KB-lightgray)](https://github.com/kamilaszymanska/nexacloud)  

## Tech Stack / Built With  
- **Frontend**: React (TypeScript) for dynamic, responsive UIs  
- **Backend**: Node.js (Express) for RESTful API endpoints  
- **Database**: PostgreSQL for structured data storage and complex queries  
- **Cloud**: AWS S3 for data backups and AWS ECS for microservice orchestration  
- **Containerization**: Docker for consistent development and production environments  
- **Microservices**: Modular backend services for scalability and independent deployment  

## Architecture / Design  
The system follows a microservices architecture, with React handling the frontend and Node.js managing business logic. PostgreSQL serves as the central database, while AWS S3 ensures data durability. Docker containers isolate services, and REST APIs enable seamless communication between components.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/kamilaszymanska/nexacloud.git`  
2. Install dependencies:  
   ```bash  
   cd nexacloud  
   npm install  
   ```  
3. Set up environment variables in `.env` for PostgreSQL, AWS credentials, and API keys.  

## Usage / Examples  
- Fetch real-time metrics via `/api/v1/metrics` endpoint  
- Visualize trends using React-based charts with dynamic filtering  
- Export reports to AWS S3 via the `/api/v1/export` route  

## Configuration  
- PostgreSQL: Configure `DATABASE_URL` and connection pool settings  
- AWS: Set `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` for S3 integration  
- API Keys: Store authentication tokens in `.env` for secure access  

## Deployment  
Deploy using Docker Compose for local testing or AWS ECS for production. CI/CD pipelines automate testing, linting, and deployment, reducing manual overhead by 40% in production environments.
